entries.rationale: Deterministic repair of the inherited provider-stop integration test's admission race (final-closure handoff §12 regression discipline; the same authorized inherited-test-repair class as the M2-F trust-anchor rotation and the gamos-plan-acceptance fixture repair). CI run 42494215014 on merge commit 12ac5906 failed honestly: expected cancels ['ask#1','ask#2'], observed ['ask#1'] — the two ask request lines can land in two child-stdout chunks, the parent admits them in two ticks, and ask#1's stop-run action (scheduled on queueMicrotask) can fire before ask#2 is admitted, changing the cancellation set. The package's own testing vocabulary already solves exactly this class (AskAction submit.delayMs, documented: 'only a real time delta can pin the order' — resume.test.ts). (1) auto-driver.ts: extend delayMs to the stop-run action (additive optional field; same scheduling path; no behavior change for actions without delayMs). (2) provider-stop.test.ts: give the stop-run action delayMs 200 so both sibling asks are admitted and in-flight before the stop lands — the invariant under test (the cancellation set and the running-status journal rows) is then pinned by real time, not by chunk luck.

The 7 skip-vs-run Blender gate tests and every other suite in the package are unaffected (verified: full package suite 100 passed + 7 honest Blender skips, same as before the change).

entries.rationale: Second instance of the same inherited-test admission-race class authorized by GAMOS-AUTH-0012 (final-closure directive §12 regression discipline — every CI-only failure fixed at its root).
